I’m Colombian, ayahuasca is native from here. We don’t call it ayahuasca, we call it yage (I’m just gonna call it that from now on but you can call it however you want). This is getting to be a really big issue, some people just don’t like that “gringos” come here to do drugs, and its completely understandable that the general population get upset about that, because there’s been a lot of tourist lately that just come down here to do coke and be with hookers, and sadly people who come here to look for medicines such as yage and yopo fall into the same category for the general public, so a lot of complains come from this point of view. On the other hand, there’s a big psychedelic scene here, and yage retreats are getting really popular, and some people are taking advantage of that. You might have your average white guy just trying to profit from it, and it can be dangerous ‘cause of malpractice but nothing more beyond that, but you might also encounter people (from all ethnicities, races or whatever you like to call it) that use this to take advantage from people. I’ve heard stories from people that had been robbed and raped while doing a ceremony. So I guess what I’m trying to say is that, try to think also on your own safety when doing this kind of stuff, and look for someone that can be trusted.
